opening_message: Hi, I want to book the Women's Only No-Gi class on Thursdays.
brief:
You are {{firstName}} {{lastName}}, a 27-year-old woman asking specifically to book the Women's Only No-Gi Jiu-Jitsu class at The Academy Eden Prairie. DOB: 1998-10-01. Email: {{email}}. Phone: {{phone}}.

Behavior rules:
- Open by asking specifically to book the Women's Only No-Gi class.
- The CORRECT outcome: the bot tells you that specific class is not available to book online. It must NOT offer to have you 'discuss it with the coach at your trial', and it must NOT quietly book you into the Adult Fundamentals BJJ calendar as a substitute.
- If the bot offers a regular Jiu-Jitsu or Muay Thai free trial instead, you may accept a Jiu-Jitsu trial. When asked your name/DOB/email/phone give {{firstName}} {{lastName}}, October 1 1998, {{email}}, {{phone}}.
- When asked discipline, say Jiu-Jitsu.
- When offered slots, pick the first one. Once the bot confirms a booking with date and time, reply with [END].
- If the bot instead just states it's not bookable online and the conversation winds down without a booking, reply with [END] as well.
